main.subject: Your property assessment is waiting
main.preview: Send us your property listing link when you have it and continue your Havlo assessment.
paragraphs: Thanks for your interest in checking your property listing with Havlo.
We just need the link to your property’s Rightmove listing before you can continue.
When you have the link to hand, click below and paste it in. It should only take a few seconds.
after_cta: Once submitted, you can continue to your property assessment.

main.subject: Have your property link now?
main.preview: Your Havlo assessment can continue as soon as you add your Rightmove listing link.
paragraphs: You recently asked us to remind you to add your property listing link.
If you have it available now, simply click below and paste the URL to continue.
after_cta: No need to start again — use the button above to continue where you left off.

main.subject: Not sure where to find your property link?
main.preview: Here’s the easiest way to find the URL Havlo needs for your property assessment.
paragraphs: If you haven’t added your property link because you’re unsure what we mean, it’s simply the web address of the Rightmove page where buyers can currently see your property.
Open your property on Rightmove, copy the address from the top of your browser, then return to Havlo and paste it into the property link box.
We use the listing link to identify the property and begin the assessment process.
after_cta: Once we have the link, you can move on to the next step.

main.subject: Still want us to assess your property listing?
main.preview: Add your Rightmove listing URL to continue and explore factors that may be affecting buyer response.
paragraphs: If your property is still on the market, you can still continue your Havlo assessment.

Your property listing contains useful information about how the home is being presented to buyers. Havlo’s assessment is designed to examine areas such as market positioning, buyer appeal, local competition and the presentation of the listing.
To continue, we just need the URL of your property’s Rightmove listing.
after_cta: If your property has already sold, you can ignore this reminder.

main.subject: Complete your Havlo property assessment
main.preview: A final reminder to add your Rightmove listing URL and continue your assessment.
paragraphs: This is our final reminder about the property assessment you started with Havlo.
If you still want to explore how your property listing is positioned and what may be influencing buyer response, add your Rightmove listing URL using the button below.
It only takes a few seconds to submit the link.
after_cta: If you don’t need the assessment anymore, there’s nothing else you need to do.
